No gameplay replay, policy change, counterfactual success or fresh strength evidence.

checks.scope: Only analysis, tests and documentation changed. Native source identity and input hashes were checked by the completed auditor.

decision.finding: Both destination selection paths discard failure context after the cooldown. Initial selection accounts for all fresh-world returns after abandonment; accepted value switches account for the directed value cycle. New timing certificates do not establish resolved exposure.
decision.next_experiment: Define a shared destination-admission decision with structured failure context and evidence-based retry conditions for both initial selection and accepted switches, preserving bounded exploration when prior evidence is incomplete.
limitations: The 74 runs reuse worlds, repeated recordings and unchanged trajectories across arms. Return events are not independent strength samples.
The next recorded visit is a same-planet return, not proof that cover, material, ownership or route feasibility stayed unchanged.
Fifteen deferring failures have no recorded return before the run ends; this does not establish permanent avoidance.

Two returns after witnessed capture failure complete their sorties, including one immediately following pursuit and cooldown expiry. Failed searches with unmeasured candidates do not prove unreachability.
The audit identifies the initial picker path without reconstructing its complete candidate geometry or claiming an alternative would succeed.
No controller, default, gameplay outcome, strength estimate or hardware-performance conclusion changes in this investigation.
